title: Areas and Lengths in Polar Coordinates
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

definitions.title: Area of a Polar Region
definitions.statement: The area swept out by rays from the pole to the curve r = f(theta) between theta = alpha and theta = beta is the integral of infinitesimal circular sectors dA = (1/2) r^2 dtheta.
definitions.explanation: Derived from circular sector area formula (1/2) r^2 Delta theta.

definitions.title: Arc Length of a Polar Curve
definitions.statement: The arc length of a smooth polar curve r = f(theta) from theta = alpha to theta = beta is the integral of the differential arc length element ds = sqrt(r^2 + (r')^2) dtheta.
definitions.explanation: Derived by applying the parametric arc length formula to x = r cos theta, y = r sin theta.
